defects.cause: After a backward flip the new current sleeve (offset 0, pointer events on) animates up from the tipped pose, in front of the front panel. A click in the first 20-30ms lands on it and opens the album. Evidence: ArrowUp then label click at 0, 10 and 20ms opened /albums/N; 30 and 40ms did nothing; from 3/4 and 2/4.
defects.verdictNote: Tester passed AC1 with (a) asserted on forward flips only and flagged the limit. Harbormaster reads a flip as either direction, so AC1 fails.

attempts.result: Fixes flipped sleeves; does not cover offset 0 sleeve animating back.
